title: Downhill From Here
description: The wall is a landscape and every ball is a guess. Tap the map on your phone to drop one, then watch it feel its way downhill one step at a time — and find out that the valley it settles in is not always the deepest one there is. This is how neural networks learn, and getting stuck is the whole problem.
action_hints: tap the map on your phone to drop a ball anywhere you like
drop two a finger-width apart and watch them end up in different valleys
hide the landscape and let the balls draw the map as they roll
turn the step size up until the balls overshoot and fly off the surface
switch the balls to marbles and see momentum carry them over a ridge
